response.script_hint: Tip: if your task requires multiple tool calls, use execute with a script to chain them in a single call and reduce token usage.

shared_parameters.offset: Pagination offset (default 0); use nextOffset from the previous page

rows: Change a GrowthBook experiment's settings (hypothesis, metrics, variations, phases, targeting, traffic split). On a running experiment the change is served from the SDKs' next refresh. Status changes go through growthbook_start_experiment and growthbook_stop_experiment.

rows.changes: JSON object with only the fields to change (same fields as growthbook_create_experiment)

rows: Stop a running GrowthBook experiment and record its result (won, lost, inconclusive, dnf). With enable_temporary_rollout, one variation is served to all of its traffic. Use after growthbook_get_experiment_results.

rows.analysis: Optional markdown conclusion shown on the results page
rows.enable_temporary_rollout: Optional boolean: keep serving released_variation_id to all of the experiment's traffic
rows.released_variation_id: Variation id to serve to everyone, with enable_temporary_rollout
rows.results: won, lost, inconclusive or dnf (did not finish)
rows.winner_variation_id: Winning variation id (var_...), when results is won

rows: Add a targeting rule (force value, percentage rollout, or experiment-ref linking an A/B test) to a GrowthBook feature flag, in a draft revision. Nothing goes live: the result has the draft version and rule ids; publish it with growthbook_publish_feature_revision. Omit version to start a new draft from the live revision. The rule must name its environments. Use after growthbook_get_feature and growthbook_list_attributes.

rows.revision_comment: Optional markdown for reviewers: what changes and why (new draft only)
rows.revision_title: Optional short title for a new draft
rows.rule: JSON object. type: force (default), rollout or experiment-ref. environments: ["production"] or allEnvironments: true (required). force/rollout: value (string form, e.g. "true" or a JSON string), condition (MongoDB-style JSON string on attributes, e.g. {"cbsa_name": "38300"}), description, enabled; rollout also coverage (0-1) and hashAttribute. experiment-ref: experimentId and variations [{variationId, value}]
rows.version: Optional draft revision version to add to; omit to create a new draft

rows: Create a GrowthBook A/B test experiment as a draft: nothing is served until it is linked to a flag with an experiment-ref rule (growthbook_add_feature_rule) and started (growthbook_start_experiment). Check growthbook_list_data_sources, growthbook_list_fact_metrics and growthbook_list_projects first.

rows.experiment: JSON object: trackingKey, name, variations [{key: "0", name: "Control"}, {key: "1", name: "Treatment"}] (required); project, hypothesis, description, owner, hashAttribute, datasourceId, assignmentQuery {id}, metrics, guardrailMetrics, tags, phases [{name, dateStarted, coverage, targetingCondition, trafficSplit}]. status is always draft

rows: List GrowthBook A/B test experiments with status (draft, running, stopped), variations, traffic split per phase, goal metrics, linked flag keys and the result summary (won, lost, inconclusive). Start here for GrowthBook experiment analysis and finding an experiment id. Paginated with limit/offset.

rows.archived: Optional boolean; true returns only archived experiments, false only active ones
rows.search: Optional search text (same syntax as the GrowthBook experiment list filter)
rows.status: Optional status filter: draft, running or stopped

rows: List GrowthBook feature flags (features) with per-environment on/off state, default value, value type, tags and targeting rules (force, rollout, experiment). Start here for GrowthBook feature flag management, finding a flag key, and checking whether a flag or rollout is enabled in production. Paginated with limit/offset.

rows.archived: Optional boolean; true includes archived flags (default false)
rows.project_id: Optional GrowthBook project id (prj_...) from growthbook_list_projects

rows: Start a new GrowthBook experiment analysis snapshot, which runs the experiment's queries against the data warehouse and updates its results. Returns the snapshot id and status; poll growthbook_get_snapshot until status is success, then read growthbook_get_experiment_results. Costs warehouse compute.

rows.dimension: Optional dimension to break results down by, e.g. exp:country
rows.phase: Optional zero-based phase index (default: latest phase)

rows: Start a draft GrowthBook experiment: users matching its targeting are assigned to variations from the SDKs' next refresh, and feature drafts linked to it may be published with it. Only call this when a person has asked to launch. An incomplete launch checklist or a required approval comes back as an error for a person; it is never skipped.

Get one GrowthBook A/B test experiment by id: hypothesis, status, variations, phases with traffic split and targeting, data source, goal, secondary and guardrail metrics, linked flag keys and result summary. Use after growthbook_list_experiments.

Get the latest GrowthBook experiment results (A/B test analysis): users per variation and, per metric, mean, percent change (lift), confidence interval, chance to beat control or p-value, plus health checks (sample ratio mismatch SRM, multiple exposures, power). Use after growthbook_get_experiment to decide a winner. Returns an error when no analysis has run; use growthbook_refresh_experiment_results first.

rows.dimension: Optional dimension to break results down by, e.g. exp:country or dim_...
rows.phase: Optional zero-based phase index (default: latest phase)

rows: Get the status (running, success, error) of a GrowthBook experiment analysis snapshot. Use after growthbook_refresh_experiment_results to know when new experiment results are ready.

List the GrowthBook audit log (change history) for an entity type or one entity: who changed a feature flag, experiment or metric, what event, when, and why. Use to investigate who toggled a flag or changed an experiment.

rows.before: Optional cursor: nextCursor from the previous page, or an ISO date-time
rows.entity_id: Optional entity id (e.g. a feature flag key); omit for every entity of the type
rows.entity_type: Entity type, e.g. feature, experiment, metric, factMetric, savedGroup, sdkConnection, project, environment

rows: List GrowthBook data sources (warehouse connections) with type, identifier types and experiment assignment queries. Connection credentials are never returned. Use to understand where experiment exposure data comes from.

List GrowthBook fact metrics (the current metric type) used as experiment goals and guardrails: name, metric type (proportion, mean, ratio, quantile, retention), fact table and column, inverse flag. Use to resolve metric ids seen in experiments and results.

List legacy GrowthBook SQL metrics (met_... ids, defined before fact metrics) with type (binomial, count, duration, revenue), data source and goal direction. Use when an experiment references a met_ metric id; prefer growthbook_list_fact_metrics for newer metrics.
